slice: Lead integration of H2b event rules/time source and H5b checkpoint composition into the Runtime
purpose: Land the two verified integration diffs in runtime.ts: the H2b declarative rule store/lifecycle/time-source pump/optional notification router (zero-model cooperative tick, close drain, read-only diagnostics) and the H5b owner-only checkpoint capture composition/command (trusted composition inputs absent by default so it stays explicitly unavailable).

changes.runtimeH2b: imports EventRuleStore/SubscriptionLifecycleService/RuleStoreSubscriptionReader/TimeSourceService/TimeSourcePump/NotificationRouter; the trusted catalog gains H2B_EVENT_TYPES (time.occurred/observation.changed); after EventService creation it builds the rule store (dataDir/control/event-rules.json), lifecycle service, reader, time source with trusted component principal, starts the cooperative zero-model TimeSourcePump (pause gate, own timer, no operation slot, no model), optionally creates the NotificationRouter only when a trusted notificationEffectPort is supplied, and includes the pump in close drain; snapshot diagnostics gain read-only timeSource snapshot and notifications enabled flag.
changes.runtimeH5b: the exact provided checkpoint patch is applied: trusted RuntimeOptions checkpointStagingRoot/checkpointRuntimeManifest (absent by default), lazy composition only on the first explicit runtime.checkpoint.capture command, dispatch before ensureCanRun so a paused runtime can snapshot, no GET/snapshot trigger, no automatic retry, and no temp fallback. With the trusted composition inputs absent the command resolves to an explicit unavailability rather than fabricating readiness.
changes.testAdaptation: the H5b evidence test previously required the integration patch to apply cleanly to an unpatched runtime.ts; once the Lead applies it, the test now verifies the integrated runtime markers instead (patch remains the integration evidence). No product behavior was weakened.
changes.visibleNewKeys: snapshot().diagnostics now includes timeSource (null before pump start or read-only projection after) and notifications {enabled:boolean}; the channels/projection and previous diagnostics keys are unchanged.

leadIsolatedIntegrationCheck.tool: scripts/slice-verify.mjs (isolated worktree at HEAD 09cf6d9 + only these 2 files)

targeted.note: runtime, host-status lossless snapshot with the new diagnostics keys, H2b subscription/time/notification suites, H5b host-ports/evidence matrix, host diagnostics tool

verification.hostValidationPending: fixed-host zero-model validation of the integrated build is performed next and committed separately; real model/channel/Effect and production checkpoint readiness remain untested.

knownLimitations: The checkpoint command stays explicitly unavailable while checkpointStagingRoot/checkpointRuntimeManifest are not supplied by trusted host composition; no host execution is claimed.
H2b time source uses plugin-owned rules only; DSH dsh-schedule is not used. No IANA DST database, no real observation/notification Effect ports and no agent-facing subscription tools.
The H5b integration test adaptation is evidence-shape only; it does not change composition or capture behavior.
evidenceLevel: G1 integration + isolated full check; fixed-host validation pending.
